questions.text: Outline any concerns regarding the impact of the Acquisition on competition, including the products your concerns relate to, whether Expedia and CarTrawler are close competitors and there are not many alternatives, or whether one is a major supplier to competitors of the other.
Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisition.
Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with Expedia and/or CarTrawler.
Outline what alternatives you consider there to be to CarTrawler’s services, including any relative strengths and weaknesses of these alternatives compared to CarTrawler’s services.

Outline what alternatives you consider there to be to Expedia’s intermediation distribution solutions in respect of lodging, flights, activities, and related services, including any relative strengths or weaknesses of these alternatives compared to Expedia’s services.

questions.section: Questions for customers of B2B car rental distribution services
questions.text: What would be involved in switching from one provider of B2B car rental distribution services (such as CarTrawler’ Connect platform) to another? Please consider factors such as costs to switch, quality of services provided, and the extent to which it is possible to implement a solution which allows integration with multiple B2B car rental distribution service providers.

questions.section: Questions for customers of B2B car rental distribution services
questions.text: In the event that CarTrawler’s Connect platform was only available when used with other related Expedia services (for example, Expedia’s B2B intermediation distribution solutions in respect of lodging, flights, activities, etc.), would this affect your choice of provider for those related services? Explain why/why not, including any barriers to changing providers.

questions.section: Questions for customers of B2B car rental distribution services
questions.text: In the event that CarTrawler’s Connect platform was not available on a standalone basis and was instead incorporated into Expedia’s OTA customer offering, to what extent would this affect your ability to compete for customers? Explain why/why not, including for which customers.

questions.section: Questions for suppliers of B2B car rental distribution services
questions.text: Explain to what extent interoperability with Expedia’s OTA platform is relevant to your ability to compete for end customers.
